Crime & Law · India

Congress questions PM's silence on Ayodhya temple fund allegations

Congress leader K.C. Venugopal has questioned Prime Minister Narendra Modi's silence regarding allegations of embezzlement of funds related to the Ram Temple in Ayodhya. The issue is expected to be a point of contention during the monsoon session of Parliament, with opposition parties planning to corner the government. Some reports also mention a widening probe into the temple's expenditure and VIP darshan practices.
